# Aquafarer

> Aquafarer designs and manufactures professional-grade inflatable watercraft — SUP boards, kayaks, dinghies, RIBs, safety equipment, and accessories — in its own 12,000 m2 factory in Qingdao, China.

Founded in 2012 in Qingdao, China, Aquafarer operates 6 production lines with 200-300 staff and an annual capacity of 15,000 units. Every unit passes a 24-48h hold at 1.25x rated pressure under an ISO 9001:2015 (SGS) quality system; products carry CE, UKCA, REACH, RoHS, AS 1799 certification, the factory is BSCI compliant, and outgoing shipments achieve a 99.3% defect-free rate (AQL 2.5 per ISO 2859 sampling). Aquafarer exports to 50+ countries. MOQ: 5-10 units for SUP/kayak, 2-5 units for RIB; sampling lead time 15-20 days, production 30-45 days. Since September 2026 the brand has been operated by Aquafarer LLC (New Mexico, USA), with R&D and production at the Aquafarer Qingdao Manufacturing Hub.

## Company

- [Products](https://aquafarer.com/hr/products/): Catalog of 64 certified inflatable watercraft — SUP boards, kayaks, dinghies, and RIBs

- [Factory](https://aquafarer.com/hr/factory/): 12,000 m2 vertically integrated factory in Laixi, Qingdao — 6 production lines, 15,000 units annual capacity
- [Quality Control](https://aquafarer.com/hr/quality/): ISO 9001:2015 quality system, 24-48h hold at 1.25x rated pressure, AQL 2.5 per ISO 2859 sampling
- [Technology](https://aquafarer.com/hr/technology/): Drop-stitch, welding, and hull technologies used in production
- [Safety](https://aquafarer.com/hr/safety/): Safety equipment standards and certified safety gear
- [Engineering Team](https://aquafarer.com/hr/engineering-team/): In-house engineering and R&D capabilities
- [About](https://aquafarer.com/hr/about/): Company background — established 2012, operated by Aquafarer LLC since September 2026, exports to 50+ countries
